rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday description of someone who does not give up easily.

example.english: They practise running every day and do not stop even when it rains; they are really tenacious.
example.traditional: 佢日日練跑，就算落雨都唔停，真係好有毅力。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat6 jat6 lin6 paau2 zau6 syun3 lok6 jyu5 dou1 m4 ting4 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 ngai6 lik6

rows.note: Use this for something that feels sticky or clings to a surface.

example.english: This syrup is sticky and tenacious, and it clings to your hand at the slightest touch.
example.traditional: 呢啲糖漿黐笠笠，掂一掂就黐住隻手。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 tong4 zoeng1 ci1 lap1 lap1 dim1 jat1 dim1 zau6 ci1 zyu6 zek3 sau2

rows.note: Use this mainly for a material or substance that holds together because it is highly cohesive.

example.english: This glue is tenacious and cohesive, so once the two pieces of wood stick together, they are hard to separate.
example.traditional: 呢種膠水黏性強，兩塊木一黐埋就好難分開。
example.jyutping: ne1 zung2 gaau1 seoi2 nim1 sing3 koeng4 loeng5 faai3 muk6 jat1 ci1 maai4 zau6 hou2 naan4 fan1 hoi1
